global.description: Platform values (global.okdp): the context's layers, the platform's (platform.yaml) then its project's (project.yaml), never an instance's.

rootCredentialsSecret.title: Root credentials Secret
rootCredentialsSecret.description: Secret of this namespace holding the keys accessKey and secretKey of the store's root (Admin) identity. Empty: <release>-root-credentials, generated once in the cluster (ESO Password generators: an access key of 20 characters, a secret key of 40).

consoleHost.title: Console host
consoleHost.description: Host name of the filer UI, behind the sign-in proxy (the platform's OIDC; not exposed without it), the ingress suffix is appended. Default: seaweedfs.<namespace>. A non-privileged project's host is <label>.<namespace> (global.okdp.policy.ingressHosts lists others).

apiHost.title: S3 API host
apiHost.description: Host name of the S3 API, the ingress suffix is appended. Default: seaweedfs-api.<namespace>. The compiler refuses a non-privileged project's host that is not <label>.<namespace> (unless the platform lists it in global.okdp.policy.ingressHosts).

oidcAllowedRoles.title: Allowed roles
oidcAllowedRoles.description: Comma-separated claim values (oidcRolesClaim) allowed to sign in to the filer UI, which reads every bucket; empty: the platform's administrators (global.okdp.access.admins).

oidcRolesClaim.title: Roles claim
oidcRolesClaim.description: Token claim carrying the values of oidcAllowedRoles.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: S3 identities, one per principal. Its keys are read by ESO from credentialsSecret (a Secret of this namespace). actions are SeaweedFS verbs (Read, Write, List, Tagging, Admin), scoped to buckets when buckets is set; sts marks a principal allowed to assume the STS role (SeaweedFS only grants it to an Admin identity). principal: letters, digits, '_', '.', '@' and '-'; buckets: bucket names.

buckets.title: Buckets
buckets.description: Buckets created at install and upgrade (OKDP's provisioning Job). name: an S3 bucket name (3 to 63 lower-case letters, digits, dots and hyphens, a letter or a digit first and last, no '..', no IP address). paths seeds prefixes for consumers that require them to exist beforehand: segments of letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' joined by single slashes, none leading or trailing (the s3 contract's). anonymousRead, objectLock, versioning, ttl: as the chart's createBuckets had them.

objectLock.description: S3 Object Lock (WORM), versioning with it; once on, it cannot be turned off.

versioning.description: The bucket's versioning; unset: left as it is.

ttl.description: The TTL of the bucket's new objects: a number and a unit (m, h, d, w, M, y).

outputSecretRef.title: Published credentials Secret
outputSecretRef.description: secretRef of the published s3 connection, a Secret consumers can use (one of that name in each consumer's namespace). Empty: none, each consumer brings its own identity.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart of the service, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

seaweedfs.title: seaweedfs
seaweedfs.description: Values of the seaweedfs chart 4.47.0 (https://seaweedfs.github.io/seaweedfs/helm), for example image, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, master/volume/filer/s3 settings, ingress annotations. Refused: nameOverride, fullnameOverride, master.enabled/port, volume.enabled/resizeHook, filer.enabled/port/s3, filer.ingresses.http.enabled/className/host/tls and its nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-* annotations, WEED_MYSQL_ENABLED in filer.extraEnvironmentVars and filer.secretExtraEnvironmentVars, s3.enabled/port/enableAuth/existingConfigSecret/extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts, s3.ingress.enabled/className/host/tls, the s3 annotation secret.reloader.stakater.com/reload, s3.createBuckets (the buckets are the parameter's: the chart's bucket hook is off), sftp, allInOne, networkPolicy.enabled, cosi. Appended to the list the service sets: s3.extraArgs. Refused too: the JWT keys of the components' environment (WEED_JWT_SIGNING_KEY, WEED_JWT_FILER_SIGNING_KEY).

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.

bucketName.description: An S3 bucket name: 3 to 63 lower-case letters, digits, dots and hyphens, a letter or a digit first and last, no '..', no IP address.

path.description: A prefix of a bucket, the s3 contract's: segments joined by single slashes, none leading or trailing.
